title: Hierarchical carbon-supported iron carbide derived from zinc–iron bimetallic coordination polymer as an efficient electrocatalyst for alkaline oxygen evolution
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35986-35997
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05402H, Paper

Tianlong Cao, Yanfang Li, Jianguo Zhao, Qihui Jiao, Wenjie Chuai, Xuefei Zhang, Zuopeng Li, Mingjun Pang
Hierarchical carbon-supported iron carbide from novel sheet-like Zn–Fe polymer aids alkaline OER. Zn-Fe ratio and pyrolysis enable pure iron carbide. Low, well-dispersed Zn doesn’t affect activity; optimized catalyst has better kinetics/stability.
